target_customer: Car dealerships buying and appraising used vehicles and trade-ins
problem: Dealers need cheaper, faster ways to appraise trade-ins and trade wholesale vehicles. AutoHub began as a digital wholesale auction marketplace and its current site sells a vehicle acquisition and appraisal tool.
product_category: automotive wholesale marketplace and trade-in appraisal

founders.name: Sam Naimi
founders.background_notes: No background on the YC page.

founders.name: Arnaud Douceur
founders.background_notes: No background on the YC page.

competitors.name: ACV Auctions
competitors.what: Online wholesale vehicle auctions for dealers from Buffalo
competitors.traction_then: Brought wholesale auctions online per a January 2017 university release

technical_complexity.rationale: A web auction marketplace with appraisal features is standard engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Marketplaces need dealer liquidity; with two people and no stated traction there was little structural protection.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large auction houses and ACV were already online by 2017; AutoHub's own fate is unclear.

market_need_then: Dealers wholesaled used cars through physical auctions and the shift online was underway in 2017; no AutoHub specific demand data was found.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name shared with several unrelated companies, including a UK dealership; no brand press found.

pivots.to: Dealer vehicle acquisition and trade-in appraisal software
pivots.why: Not stated; inferred from YC listing versus current autohub.io content, and it is unclear whether the current site is the same company.

outcome_analysis: AutoHub was a two person S17 YC company building a wholesale auto auction marketplace; YC lists it as acquired but no acquirer, date or price was found. The current autohub.io appears to sell a dealer acquisition tool and may be a later or different business. With no funding or exit details public, no cause for the outcome can be assigned.
notes: CB Insights and Munich Startup list about 120K raised across two rounds (a seed in August 2017 and a November 2017 round with AltaIR Capital and Y Combinator); aggregators only, unverified, so no rounds recorded. The acquisition is stated only on the YC page; acquirer unknown. The autohub.io site shows a live current product, so the YC acquired status could not be reconciled with it. ACV competitor listing relies on a search snippet of the 2017 release; its traction is as described there. Founded year not stated.
